comment: The Open Standards condition names HL7 FHIR as the primary framework for health data exchange alongside ICD, LOINC and SNOMED CT, and the full-STAC "S" box in Figure 2.2 lists HL7 FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC and CQL. Each is an exchange or terminology standard; no formalism is named for the structure of persisted clinical data. Appendix C requires the LIMR to support openEHR archetypes and templates (page 175, functional requirement 2, status Required) and names them again at pages 172 and 174. The enabling conditions, which are where ministries and procurement teams look, do not reflect what Appendix C requires.
